normalization.Q15_Q30: Cone-emitted power per projected unit-cell area divided by equal-temperature 8-13 um blackbody hemispherical exitance; not a percentage of this emitter's output
normalization.C15_C30: Q15/Q30 divided by hemispherical band emissivity
normalization.integration: Trapezoid Planck weighting in lambda; trapezoid in sin²(theta), periodic uniform phi average; 89..90 constant tail; constant Lambertian normalization exact

comsol_flat.scope: Actual 3D RF solves, but only an infinite flat scalar-Ti-impedance surface at 10.5 um. Flat tiny period has one propagating order, unlike the future 80 um cavity. No cavity, broadband, fabricated TA2, film or geometric-optics qualification.

ranking_interpretation: At alpha0.9, dense and matched coarse integration retain the Q15 and Q30 winners and complete Q orders; A0 H120 versus H90 Q15 gap is about 1.64% in dense, 1.95% coarse.
C15 near-tie ordering of A0 H90 and A3 H90 changes under coarse integration. Do not insist on an absolute concentration winner between them.
At alpha0.5, A3 H120 edges A0 H120 in Q15 by only about 0.093%; preserve both as a near tie, not an established unique new optimum.
A3 H120 remains Q30 winner at all three assumed alphas. None of these sampled checks bounds full-wave or real-material ranking errors.
sensitivity.same_grid: 7 wavelengths, 217 directions; alpha0.9 65536 spatial rays versus alpha0.5/0.7 32768, with paired seed; no new solves
sensitivity.caveat: Grey absorptance is a hypothetical material-control parameter, not a physical film specification. Coarse-versus-dense deltas measure sampled quadrature sensitivity only, not a rigorous global error bound.

scope_limits: Geometric-ray specular local bulk-Ti model; no diffraction/interference or roughness/film calibration
M1 all bulk-Ti proxy; M2 grey floor alpha assumed and grey residual phase PEC-like
8-13 um target band, Planck 523 K assumption; no current 3-20 um performance inference
All-surface emissivity interpretation assumes reciprocal opaque isothermal structure
A_wall is all non-floor Ti, including cavity sidewalls and horizontal top lands; not sidewall-only absorption
A0 endpoint-remapped CPC-inspired geometry, not a mathematically ideal CPC for every height/bottom
No automatic FWHM; sampled emissivity maxima can lie on plateaus/azimuthal microstructure; not proof of designed off-axis lobe
No old coarse size-screen numerical merge: quadrature differs, so numerical shifts are not automatically solver errors
Reported marginal MC SE and selected seed/segment controls do not bound wave/model/quadrature/physical-material error
